mappings.note: The author's primary message -- embracing the new need not mean abandoning respect for the old. Interpreting the play's meaning as a whole; LO-25 is about how the tension is built and released rather than what the play finally says, so C-2.2 competency.
Who is in the band and what each plays -- recall, C-2.2 competency. Not LO-28: the instruments are listed, not used as terminology inside dialogue.
How the public first reacts to Shruti's talent (praised as a sensation in the newspaper) -- recall, C-2.2 competency.
Why Nabin counts as a strict traditionalist -- his stated views on musical purity. Comprehension of a character's position, C-2.2 competency.
Why she is terrified to reveal the band -- the fear that sets the play's tension running, C-2.2-LO-25, not bare recall.
What advice the friends give -- to face it bravely and speak openly. The advice is the point, not the idiom that carries it, so C-2.2 competency rather than LO-28.
Why she hesitates to hurt her father despite her passion -- the duty-against-passion pull that is the play's core tension, C-2.2-LO-25.
When and how she breaks the news (at dinner, begging him to attend one rehearsal) -- plot recall, C-2.2 competency.
Why Leela scolds her -- for the hiding, not the music. A distinction of motive read off the dialogue, C-2.2 competency. DEFECT: 'NODIA' page furniture is appended to the answer.
What she begs him to attend (one rehearsal) -- recall, C-2.2 competency.
Nabin's reaction to the news (strong disapproval) -- the refusal that raises the tension to its peak, C-2.2-LO-25.

He says she has lost her sense of true MUSICALITY -- the item turns on a musical term and on what it sounds like coming from him, which is what C-2.2-LO-28 covers. The distractors (responsibility, dedication, creativity) are all non-musical, so the term is what is being tested.
The mother's name (Leela) -- recall, C-2.2 competency.
Which statement about the dinner confrontation is correct -- the scene where the conflict comes to a head, and the distractors are alternative resolutions. C-2.2-LO-25.
What she promises after the scolding (never to hide things) -- recall, C-2.2 competency. Not LO-25: the promise is about honesty, not about the music conflict.
She is torn between her passion and her FAMILY DUTY -- the two poles of the play's tension named outright, C-2.2-LO-25.
What she decides matters more (family duty) -- the low point before the release, C-2.2-LO-25.
What she plans to tell her friends (that she has to quit) -- plot recall, C-2.2 competency.

Why she practises the fusion piece one last time -- the answer is available only from her ASIDE ('Perhaps I can practise one last time and soon after that I will tell them that I can't join them'). The audience knows her intent and her friends do not, which is C-2.2-LO-26 exactly.
